directive: 通知の発生状況と話者を踏まえ、必要な情報を簡潔に伝える。変数を保つ。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Well... Theoretically, the human immune system was supposed to be the cure. Initial tests on humanoids revealed the following: death rate reached up to 50%, another 48% lost their mind faculties, sometimes suffering secondary infections with HIV and only 2% of those tested survived relatively unscathed, but... still, their central nervous system had been affected and would continue to degrade over time.
entries.JA_current: Well... Theoretically, the human immune system was supposed to be the cure. Initial tests on humanoids revealed the following: death rate reached up to 50%, another 48% lost their mind faculties, sometimes suffering secondary infections with HIV and only 2% of those tested survived relatively unscathed, but... still, their central nervous system had been affected and would continue to degrade over time.
entries.JA_new: 理論上は、人間の免疫系が治療法になるはずでした。人間に対する初期試験では、死亡率は50％に達し、さらに48％は知的能力を失いました。HIVの二次感染を起こす例もあり、比較的無傷で生き残ったのは、被験者のわずか2％です……それでも中枢神経系は侵され、時間とともに機能が衰えていくでしょう。

entries.EN: Are you saying that I've been lucky to be one of those 2%?
entries.JA_current: Are you saying that I've been lucky to be one of those 2%?
entries.JA_new: じゃあ、俺はその2％に入った運のいい奴だってことか？

entries.EN: As far as it seems to me - yes. But don't think the "ZNOY-13" shortened your life. Don't despair, the reports on the research state that you may stay alive for decades. Besides, the Zone itself is an unconventional area, even common diseases don't take their normal course here. One more thing I wanted to tell you: academician Shelestov was the one to lead the research on the "ZNOY-13" project before it was appropriated by the government, and he may be entering the Zone soon for a planned expedition. If I manage to stay alive until then, I'll acquaint you, maybe he will be able to help with your issue. But how will I find you?
entries.JA_current: As far as it seems to me - yes. But don't think the "ZNOY-13" shortened your life. Don't despair, the reports on the research state that you may stay alive for decades. Besides, the Zone itself is an unconventional area, even common diseases don't take their normal course here. One more thing I wanted to tell you: academician Shelestov was the one to lead the research on the "ZNOY-13" project before it was appropriated by the government, and he may be entering the Zone soon for a planned expedition. If I manage to stay alive until then, I'll acquaint you, maybe he will be able to help with your issue. But how will I find you?
entries.JA_new: 私にはそう思えます。でも、「ZNOY-13」のせいで寿命が縮んだと決めつけないでください。絶望しないで。研究報告では、何十年も生きられる可能性があるとされています。それに、ゾーンは普通の場所ではありません。一般的な病気でさえ、ここでは通常とは違う経過をたどります。もう一つ伝えておきたいことがあります。政府に接収される前、「ZNOY-13」計画を率いていたのは学士院会員のシェレストフです。彼は近いうち、予定されている遠征でゾーンに来るかもしれません。それまで私が生きていられたら、あなたを彼に紹介します。あなたの問題を解決できるかもしれません。でも、どうやってあなたを見つけましょう？

entries.EN: There's a bar named "100 Rads" over at the Rostok industrial complex. I'll give the documents to the Barkeep. Talk to him when you're ready to speak with me. Just mention the term "Znoy" when talking to him. This will be the signal so he knows who you are. So long!
entries.JA_current: There's a bar named "100 Rads" over at the Rostok industrial complex. I'll give the documents to the Barkeep. Talk to him when you're ready to speak with me. Just mention the term "Znoy" when talking to him. This will be the signal so he knows who you are. So long!
entries.JA_new: ロストク工業地帯に「100レントゲン」というバーがある。書類はバーキープに預けておく。私と話す気になったら、彼に声をかけてくれ。「ズノイ」と言えば、誰か分かる合図になる。それじゃ。

entries.EN: Ppppleeasee... Helppp...
entries.JA_current: Ppppleeasee... Helppp...
entries.JA_new: た、たすけ……助けて……

entries.EN: How are you?
entries.JA_current: How are you?
entries.JA_new: 大丈夫か？

entries.EN: Hail, stalker!
entries.JA_current: Hail, stalker!
entries.JA_new: よう、ストーカー！

entries.EN: Hello! Look, do you happen to know the stalker who went to the X18 lab recently?
entries.JA_current: Hello! Look, do you happen to know the stalker who went to the X18 lab recently?
entries.JA_new: こんにちは！　最近X-18の研究所へ行ったストーカーを知らないか？

entries.EN: I do, I do! I think you mean Serega the Maniac. He has become something of a local legend after his trip down to the X18 lab, you heard about that?
entries.JA_current: I do, I do! I think you mean Serega the Maniac. He has become something of a local legend after his trip down to the X18 lab, you heard about that?
entries.JA_new: 知ってる、知ってる！　マニアックのセレガだろ。X-18へ行ってから、ちょっとした地元の伝説になったんだ。聞いたことあるか？

entries.EN: Maybe... So, where is he now?
entries.JA_current: Maybe... So, where is he now?
entries.JA_new: たぶんな……今はどこにいる？

entries.EN: He went to Sidorovich. You've missed each other.
entries.JA_current: He went to Sidorovich. You've missed each other.
entries.JA_new: シドロヴィッチのところへ行ったよ。すれ違いだったな。

entries.EN: I see. Thanks for the info, stalker.
entries.JA_current: I see. Thanks for the info, stalker.
entries.JA_new: そうか。情報ありがとう、ストーカー。

entries.EN: Sidorovich! Has a stalker by the nickname "Maniac" stopped by here recently?
entries.JA_current: Sidorovich! Has a stalker by the nickname "Maniac" stopped by here recently?
entries.JA_new: シドロヴィッチ！　「マニアック」ってあだ名のストーカーが、最近ここに来なかったか？

entries.EN: Yes, he has. Not too long ago... How did you know about that?
entries.JA_current: Yes, he has. Not too long ago... How did you know about that?
entries.JA_new: 来たとも。つい最近な……どうして知ってる？

entries.EN: Doesn't matter. Did he say where he was heading?
entries.JA_current: Doesn't matter. Did he say where he was heading?
entries.JA_new: それはいい。どこへ向かうと言ってた？

entries.EN: Of course not! Since when did stalkers begin to report to me about their intentions? He came here to trade and that's that, but... Wait. He mentioned he was going to halt... Here... At Cordon, somewhere north of the path to the Dark Valley, he's got a camp there.
entries.JA_current: Of course not! Since when did stalkers begin to report to me about their intentions? He came here to trade and that's that, but... Wait. He mentioned he was going to halt... Here... At Cordon, somewhere north of the path to the Dark Valley, he's got a camp there.
entries.JA_new: 言うわけないだろ！　ストーカーが行き先を俺に報告するようになったのはいつからだ？　取引に来ただけだよ……ああ、待てよ。少し休むと言ってたな……ここだ。コルドンの、ダークバレーへ向かう道より北のどこかにキャンプがあるらしい。

entries.EN: Wonderful! And you keep complaining nobody's telling you anything!
entries.JA_current: Wonderful! And you keep complaining nobody's telling you anything!
entries.JA_new: すごいな！　それで、誰も何も教えてくれないって愚痴ってたのか？

entries.EN: Well, it's true, nobody tells me anything, I just happen to be very attentive, comes with the trade. Now, how about you, are you gonna tell me what you need him for?
entries.JA_current: Well, it's true, nobody tells me anything, I just happen to be very attentive, comes with the trade. Now, how about you, are you gonna tell me what you need him for?
entries.JA_new: 実際、誰も教えてくれないさ。商売柄、耳がいいだけだ。さて、お前は何のためにあいつを捜してるんだ？

entries.EN: I have a deal I'd like to discuss with him, that is all. See you around!
entries.JA_current: I have a deal I'd like to discuss with him, that is all. See you around!
entries.JA_new: 話したい取引がある。それだけだ。またな！

entries.EN: Good day!
entries.JA_current: Good day!
entries.JA_new: こんにちは！

entries.EN: Hello. Are you "the Maniac"?
entries.JA_current: Hello. Are you "the Maniac"?
entries.JA_new: やあ。「マニアック」か？

entries.EN: That's exactly who I am. Have you been looking for me?
entries.JA_current: That's exactly who I am. Have you been looking for me?
entries.JA_new: そのとおりだ。俺を捜してたのか？

entries.EN: I have...
entries.JA_current: I have...
entries.JA_new: そうだ……

entries.EN: And what's the point?
entries.JA_current: And what's the point?
entries.JA_new: 何の用だ？

entries.EN: I've got a couple of questions for you about your trip to the X18. For example: who killed the soldiers by the entrance?
entries.JA_current: I've got a couple of questions for you about your trip to the X18. For example: who killed the soldiers by the entrance?
entries.JA_new: X-18へ行った時のことで、いくつか聞きたい。たとえば、入口にいた兵士を殺したのは誰だ？

entries.EN: I did... Why, are we gonna have a problem? You some type of military investigator sent to find out who wasted their precious squad?
entries.JA_current: I did... Why, are we gonna have a problem? You some type of military investigator sent to find out who wasted their precious squad?
entries.JA_new: 俺だ……それで、揉め事でも起こす気か？　大切な分隊を潰した犯人を捜す、ミリタリーの調査員か？

entries.EN: No, not really. Interesting that you were so forthcoming about it, though.
entries.JA_current: No, not really. Interesting that you were so forthcoming about it, though.
entries.JA_new: いや、別に。あっさり認めたのが意外だっただけだ。

entries.EN: Of-course, I don't keep that a secret.
entries.JA_current: Of-course, I don't keep that a secret.
entries.JA_new: もちろんだ。隠すつもりはない。

entries.EN: And why did you waste them? If you don't keep THAT a secret?
entries.JA_current: And why did you waste them? If you don't keep THAT a secret?
entries.JA_new: 隠さないなら、どうして殺したのかも話せるだろ？

entries.EN: That ain't a secret either, but you're not a priest, and I don't intend to confess all of my sins to you just now.
entries.JA_current: That ain't a secret either, but you're not a priest, and I don't intend to confess all of my sins to you just now.
entries.JA_new: それも秘密じゃない。だが、お前は神父じゃないし、今ここで罪を全部告白する気はない。

entries.EN: Evidently not... Can you at least tell me anything about the door with the combination lock?
entries.JA_current: Evidently not... Can you at least tell me anything about the door with the combination lock?
entries.JA_new: そうだろうな……せめて、暗証番号式の扉について何か知らないか？

entries.EN: The soldiers locked it. They set up a watch perimeter... But it didn't stop me, though.
entries.JA_current: The soldiers locked it. They set up a watch perimeter... But it didn't stop me, though.
entries.JA_new: 兵士たちが鍵をかけて、見張りを配置していた……だが、俺は止められなかった。

entries.EN: So why waste them?
entries.JA_current: So why waste them?
entries.JA_new: それで、どうして殺した？

entries.EN: What do you mean: "Why"?! You would do the same if not more, had they killed YOUR brother!
entries.JA_current: What do you mean: "Why"?! You would do the same if not more, had they killed YOUR brother!
entries.JA_new: どうしてだと？　奴らがお前の兄弟を殺していたら、お前だって同じことをしただろ！　もっとひどいことをな！

entries.EN: Ahh, so that's the reason! Now I see. Well, many have lost their nearest and dearest, but none of them become maniacs, charging into military strong-points.
entries.JA_current: Ahh, so that's the reason! Now I see. Well, many have lost their nearest and dearest, but none of them become maniacs, charging into military strong-points.
entries.JA_new: ああ、そういうことか！　ようやく分かった。だが、身内を失った奴は大勢いる。だからといって、誰もお前みたいにミリタリーの拠点へ突っ込む狂人にはならない。

entries.EN: You don't know anything about the matter, so how about you shut up. Or else I can make you shut up!
entries.JA_current: You don't know anything about the matter, so how about you shut up. Or else I can make you shut up!
entries.JA_new: 何も知らないくせに、黙ってろ。さもないと、俺がお前を黙らせるぞ！

entries.EN: Look, stalker, I need to get into that laboratory, but the door is locked. I need the combination.
entries.JA_current: Look, stalker, I need to get into that laboratory, but the door is locked. I need the combination.
entries.JA_new: なあ、ストーカー。あの研究所に入りたいが、扉に鍵がかかってる。暗証番号が必要なんだ。

entries.EN: The combination... I've heard about that. When I got down into the lab, one of the officers was posting security watchmen. He told them to shut the door in extreme situations only and instructed that someone must be at the door at all times. As for the combination, he mentioned "Nevskaya Bitva". He meant the date of the battle, I guess... Something like day, month and year, most probably. 15th of July, 1240, if I'm not mistaken? That's all, I suppose.
entries.JA_current: The combination... I've heard about that. When I got down into the lab, one of the officers was posting security watchmen. He told them to shut the door in extreme situations only and instructed that someone must be at the door at all times. As for the combination, he mentioned "Nevskaya Bitva". He meant the date of the battle, I guess... Something like day, month and year, most probably. 15th of July, 1240, if I'm not mistaken? That's all, I suppose.
entries.JA_new: 暗証番号か……聞いたことがある。研究所へ降りた時、将校の一人が見張りを配置していた。緊急時以外は扉を閉めるな、誰かが常に入口にいろ、と指示していた。それから番号について「ネフスカヤ・ビトヴァ」と言っていた。たぶん戦いの日付のことだろう……日、月、年の順だと思う。1240年7月15日だったはずだ。以上だ。

entries.EN: "Battle of the Neva", you say... I'll check it out...
entries.JA_current: "Battle of the Neva", you say... I'll check it out...
entries.JA_new: 「ネヴァ川の戦い」か……調べてみる……

entries.EN: What's in it for you down there anyway?
entries.JA_current: What's in it for you down there anyway?
entries.JA_new: そもそも、地下で何をするつもりなんだ？

entries.EN: I don't know that myself... Yet...
entries.JA_current: I don't know that myself... Yet...
entries.JA_new: 俺にもまだ分からない……

entries.EN: Professor, there's something that's been bugging me.
entries.JA_current: Professor, there's something that's been bugging me.
entries.JA_new: 教授、気になっていることがあるんです。

entries.EN: I'm all ears, young man...
entries.JA_current: I'm all ears, young man...
entries.JA_new: 聞かせてくれ、若者よ……

entries.EN: Why are there so many zombies around here?
entries.JA_current: Why are there so many zombies around here?
entries.JA_new: どうしてこの辺にはゾンビがこんなに多いんです？

entries.EN: When the emissions at Yantar were switched off and the area became accessible, many stalkers were attracted here from all over the Zone, with tales of abundant loot and untapped seas of "rich swag" circulating around like a disease. They all came hunting after the artifacts which were now perfectly accessible and ripe for the taking, but... They were not alone, something began to crawl out of the underground complex out there, and it had an effect on the prospectors. Many of those initial artifact hunters complained of hallucinations and headaches, we thought it may have been some type of an electromagnetic "echo" of the emissions, didn't worry about it too much, the stalkers usually had a smoke and felt much better. It wasn't long before we received word of unwanted guests at the complex, and the situation became apparent very quickly after that. By the time we realized there were controllers crawling all over the ruins, it was too late, many stalkers succumbed to their psi-influence and lost their minds. Mind you, that hasn't stopped other Stalkers from trying their luck, many have since come to take their shot at pinching an artifact or two before their brains fry. Well, the consequences can be easily predicted... And observed...

entries.JA_new: ヤンターの光熱放射が止まり、立ち入りが可能になると、ゾーン中からストーカーが集まってきました。「ここには戦利品が山ほど眠っている」という噂が、病気のように広まったのです。彼らは、手つかずのアーティファクトを求めてやって来ました。しかし……彼らだけではなかった。地下施設から何かが這い出し、探索者たちに影響を及ぼし始めたのです。初期のアーティファクト探しの連中は、幻覚や頭痛を訴えました。私たちは光熱放射の電磁的な「残響」だろうと考え、あまり気に留めませんでした。ストーカーたちは一服すれば、たいてい楽になっていたのです。ほどなくして、施設に招かれざる客がいるという報告が入り、事態はすぐに明らかになりました。遺跡にコントローラーがうろついていると気づいた時には、もう手遅れでした。多くのストーカーがサイの影響に屈し、正気を失っていたのです。それでも、運試しに来る者は後を絶ちません。脳が焼かれる前にアーティファクトを一つ二つ持ち出そうと、次々にやってきます。結果は簡単に予想できます……実際に見れば分かるでしょう……

entries.EN: Professor, I'm back.
entries.JA_current: Professor, I'm back.
entries.JA_new: 教授、戻りました。

entries.EN: It's a pleasure for me to see you in good health. Have you found the answers for those questions of yours?
entries.JA_current: It's a pleasure for me to see you in good health. Have you found the answers for those questions of yours?
entries.JA_new: 元気な姿を見られて嬉しいよ。あの質問の答えは見つかったかね？

entries.EN: On the contrary, the number of questions has increased.
entries.JA_current: On the contrary, the number of questions has increased.
entries.JA_new: 逆です。疑問が増えました。

entries.EN: Haven't you found anything?
entries.JA_current: Haven't you found anything?
entries.JA_new: 何も見つからなかったのかね？

entries.EN: Indeed I have...
entries.JA_current: Indeed I have...
entries.JA_new: いえ、見つけました……

entries.EN: Would you allow me to take a look?
entries.JA_current: Would you allow me to take a look?
entries.JA_new: 見せてもらってもいいかな？

entries.EN: Sure, help yourself.
entries.JA_current: Sure, help yourself.
entries.JA_new: どうぞ、ご覧ください。

entries.EN: I don't think so.
entries.JA_current: I don't think so.
entries.JA_new: いや、やめておきます。

entries.EN: Oh, my God!
entries.JA_current: Oh, my God!
entries.JA_new: 何ということだ！

entries.EN: What?
entries.JA_current: What?
entries.JA_new: どうしたんです？

entries.EN: "ZNOY-13" appears to be a dreadful biological weapon. Just take a look at those photos!
entries.JA_current: "ZNOY-13" appears to be a dreadful biological weapon. Just take a look at those photos!
entries.JA_new: 「ZNOY-13」は恐ろしい生物兵器らしい。あの写真を見てくれ！

entries.EN: Whoa, this shit has been tested on human beings?!
entries.JA_current: Whoa, this shit has been tested on human beings?!
entries.JA_new: くそっ、人間で実験したのか？！

entries.EN: Yes... On prisoners, according to the sample data in the notebook.
entries.JA_current: Yes... On prisoners, according to the sample data in the notebook.
entries.JA_new: そうだ……記録帳のデータによれば、囚人たちが被験者にされた。

entries.EN: What a rotten affair.
entries.JA_current: What a rotten affair.
entries.JA_new: なんて卑劣なことを。

entries.EN: Listen to me, Marked One. These documents must be protected at ALL cost, they can never fall into the wrong hands! I implore you, give them to me and I will hand them to the government.
entries.JA_current: Listen to me, Marked One. These documents must be protected at ALL cost, they can never fall into the wrong hands! I implore you, give them to me and I will hand them to the government.
entries.JA_new: いいか、マークドワン。書類は何としても守らなければならない。決して悪人の手に渡してはいけない！　頼む、私に渡してくれ。政府に届けよう。

entries.EN: No, not to the government! No way! It was the government which became interested in the "ZNOY-13" in the first place. Here, take a look at these notes, right here.
entries.JA_current: No, not to the government! No way! It was the government which became interested in the "ZNOY-13" in the first place. Here, take a look at these notes, right here.
entries.JA_new: 政府には渡せません！　そもそも「ZNOY-13」に興味を持ったのは政府なんです。ほら、このメモを見てください。

entries.EN: This.. This cannot be true!.. The Military intended to carry out field testing of the virus in the Zone! Are they insane?! There are people here, good people!
entries.JA_current: This.. This cannot be true!.. The Military intended to carry out field testing of the virus in the Zone! Are they insane?! There are people here, good people!
entries.JA_new: そ、そんな……本当なのか……！　ミリタリーはゾーンでウイルスの野外実験をするつもりだったのか！　正気か？　ここには人がいるんだ、善良な人たちが！

entries.EN: People, you say. To them we're just expendable guinea pigs.
entries.JA_current: People, you say. To them we're just expendable guinea pigs.
entries.JA_new: 人だって？　奴らにとって、俺たちは使い捨てのモルモットだ。

entries.EN: It's too terrible to even think about! They think they'll be able to contain it within the Zone, but if this gets out to the outside world... Not only that, the Zone can have strange, unforeseen effects on this virus, mutation is likely, and who knows where it would progress from there!
entries.JA_current: It's too terrible to even think about! They think they'll be able to contain it within the Zone, but if this gets out to the outside world... Not only that, the Zone can have strange, unforeseen effects on this virus, mutation is likely, and who knows where it would progress from there!
entries.JA_new: 考えるだけでも恐ろしい！　ゾーンの中だけに封じ込められると思っているのだろうが、外へ漏れたら……それだけではない。ゾーンはウイルスに予測できない影響を与える可能性がある。変異するかもしれないし、その先どうなるか誰にも分からない！

entries.EN: Don't despair, Professor. It is us who have the documents.
entries.JA_current: Don't despair, Professor. It is us who have the documents.
entries.JA_new: 絶望しないでください、教授。書類は僕たちが持っています。

entries.EN: Yes, the documents... But the samples! The samples that were obtained during research - they are still hidden around field labs set up in the depths of the Zone! They must be acquired before the Military get them!
entries.JA_current: Yes, the documents... But the samples! The samples that were obtained during research - they are still hidden around field labs set up in the depths of the Zone! They must be acquired before the Military get them!
entries.JA_new: そう、書類だ……だが、サンプルはどうする？　研究で使われたサンプルは、ゾーン深部にある野外研究所にまだ隠されている！　ミリタリーに渡る前に確保しなければ！

entries.EN: I guess I know of a person who might be of help. Did a stalker from Freedom come to you not long before my visit?
entries.JA_current: I guess I know of a person who might be of help. Did a stalker from Freedom come to you not long before my visit?
entries.JA_new: 力になってくれそうな人物を知っています。僕が来る少し前に、フリーダムのストーカーが訪ねてきませんでしたか？

entries.EN: Yes, he did. He also asked about the increased activity of the zombies.
entries.JA_current: Yes, he did. He also asked about the increased activity of the zombies.
entries.JA_new: 来たよ。ゾンビが増えていることについても質問していた。

entries.EN: Do you have any idea where he went afterwards?
entries.JA_current: Do you have any idea where he went afterwards?
entries.JA_new: その後どこへ行ったか、分かりますか？

entries.EN: Unfortunately, none... But it seemed to me he was going to the laboratory.
entries.JA_current: Unfortunately, none... But it seemed to me he was going to the laboratory.
entries.JA_new: 残念ながら分からない……ただ、研究所へ向かうつもりのようだった。

entries.EN: I met no stalkers down there.
entries.JA_current: I met no stalkers down there.
entries.JA_new: 地下ではストーカーを見ませんでした。

entries.EN: Well, perhaps he never made it in? What if he's still looking for a way in then.
entries.JA_current: Well, perhaps he never made it in? What if he's still looking for a way in then.
entries.JA_new: なら、まだ入れていないのかもしれない。入口を探しているところでは？

entries.EN: It's possible, I'll have a look.
entries.JA_current: It's possible, I'll have a look.
entries.JA_new: そうかもしれません。探してみます。

entries.EN: No. First of all, one should check their base for some unattended electronic stuff. Shit happens - somebody may have left his computer unlocked or left a USB laying around. If you are on good terms with the Freedom guys, then I'm sure you can get into their base effortlessly. Not only that, they're so doped up over there, I bet they won't even notice you nosing around! Heh, they'll probably think you're searching for a stash of drugs and maybe they'll even help you search... Yeah, it's got to be you. If I went anywhere within sight of their base, they'd light me up first and not even bother to ask questions later.

entries.JA_new: いや、まずは基地を調べて、放置された電子機器を探すべきだ。誰かがパソコンを開いたままにしたり、USBメモリを置き忘れたりすることはある。フリーダムと仲がいいなら、簡単に基地へ入れるだろう。それに、向こうは薬でラリってる。こっちがうろついても気づかないさ！　麻薬の隠し場所を探してると思って、一緒に探してくれるかもな……やっぱり、お前が行くしかない。俺が基地の近くへ行けば、質問もせずに撃たれる。

entries.EN: Let the pro handle the matter. Well now... There we go... Hah, nothing to it, like opening a can of cold beer. Let's check for any info about "Outrage". Wait... Hmmm... No info about him, but there's some news about a guy from his squad. This intel report states that this guy was found to be kissing Duty's ass. No exact location is given, but he is suspected to be hiding somewhere in the vicinity of the military base. Last known whereabouts and direction of travel suggest an abandoned village in the area... Yeah, I know that village, had a tangle with a bloodsucker over there one time, still gives me goosebumps thinking about it! Well, seems like as place to search for tracks, don't you think?

entries.JA_new: ここはプロに任せろ。さてと……よし、こんなもんか。冷えたビールの缶を開けるくらい簡単だ。まずは「アウトレイジ」の情報を探そう。待てよ……うーん、本人の情報はないが、部下についての記事がある。この情報報告によると、そいつはデューティーに尻尾を振っていたらしい。正確な場所は不明だが、ミリタリー基地の近くに隠れていると思われる。最後に確認された場所と移動方向からすると、近くの廃村だな……ああ、知ってる。前にそこでブラッドサッカーと揉めて、思い出すだけでも鳥肌が立つ！　足取りを追うなら、あそこがよさそうだな？

entries.EN: I don't know. I wish I could get a hold of that bastard myself. Hey, here's a suggestion. You can kill two birds with one stone. Look, I'm not too eager to help those morons from Duty, but... "Outrage" intends to provoke an Army attack on the bar. For that purpose he is going to disguise himself and his men in Duty uniforms and he will brutally execute several soldiers that he took as hostages. The execution will be recorded on video and the tape will be sent to the Military HQs to trigger a rapid, violent retaliation. Quite a good plan, we'd never do something like that but I bet if the roles were reversed, Duty would love to wipe us out and something like this wouldn't be beneath them.

entries.JA_new: 分からない。俺自身であの野郎を捕まえたいくらいだ。そうだ、いい案がある。これなら一石二鳥だ。デューティーの馬鹿どもを助ける気はあまりないが……「アウトレイジ」は軍にバーを襲撃させようとしている。自分と部下にデューティーの制服を着せ、人質にした兵士を何人か残虐に処刑するつもりだ。処刑を映像に撮ってミリタリー司令部へ送りつけ、即座に激しい報復を誘う。なかなかの計画だ。俺たちはそんなことはしないが、立場が逆ならデューティーだって俺たちを皆殺しにするだろう。あいつらならやりかねない。

entries.EN: Ya've seen too many low-grade Hollywood bullshit, or what? Listen to what I'm telling ya. See those fellas? Ya make a move they don't like n' they're gonna stuff you full of lead. That's how. As for the case... You may try askin' those jar-heads about it, they're looking for it too. If ya want - ya hurry up to the Wild Territory, the building with the crane next to it, they went ova' there not long ago. I'd whack 'em myself, but we lack the manpower. Let me give ya a heads up - they're most likely gonna waste you and not even give a rat's ass who you are!

entries.JA_new: 安っぽいハリウッド映画の見すぎか？　いいか、よく聞け。あいつらが見えるだろ？　気に入らない動きをしたら、蜂の巣にされる。それだけだ。ケースのことなら、あの軍人どもに聞いてみろ。奴らも捜してる。行くなら急いで荒廃領域へ向かえ。クレーンのある建物だ。ついさっき、あいつらが向かった。俺が片づけたいところだが、人手が足りない。忠告しておく。奴らはお前を撃つだろうし、お前が誰かなんて気にもしないぞ！

entries.EN: No, Barkeep. I'm sick and tired of poking my nose into every hornet's next around the Zone for you and Sidorovich. The Military must have set an impressive reward for my head already.
entries.JA_current: No, Barkeep. I'm sick and tired of poking my nose into every hornet's next around the Zone for you and Sidorovich. The Military must have set an impressive reward for my head already.
entries.JA_new: いやだ、バーキープ。ゾーン中で、お前やシドロヴィッチのために厄介事へ首を突っ込むのはもううんざりだ。ミリタリーは、俺の首に相当な懸賞金をかけてるだろう。

entries.EN: What's happening here? Why did the Military attack the Bar?
entries.JA_current: What's happening here? Why did the Military attack the Bar?
entries.JA_new: 何があったんだ？　どうしてミリタリーがバーを襲った？

entries.EN: I have no idea. I hope it doesn't mean a war is starting.
entries.JA_current: I have no idea. I hope it doesn't mean a war is starting.
entries.JA_new: さあな。戦争が始まる前触れじゃないといいが。
